title: Integrated AlphaHoldem Seed1 one-million-hand deep convergence control
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The sole 262k lineage that passed the original four-anchor and both-seat breadth gate will recover a positive broad frozen slope after exact-state continuation to 1,048,576 actual environment hands, distinguishing a genuinely slow long-horizon recipe from the nonmonotone high-variance 149k-to-262k regime.
material_change: Continue only Seed1 from 263,423 to 1,048,576 actual hands with identical Trinal-Clip PPO, replay, loss-K-best pool, adaptive league, Standard10 KL, optimizer, and assignment RNG state; move to a nonoverlapping fixed-deal window and perform no Slumbot evaluation during training.
baseline: Seed1 at 263,423 actual hands: original fresh four-anchor 70k-to-262k slope +1.221 bb/100 with 3/4 anchors and both seats positive; independent two-anchor archive panel was negative, demonstrating high panel variance.

notes: Promotion requires exact continuation/accounting, no replay recovery or KL/ratio collapse, Standard10 drift PASS, and a fresh 4096-pair-per-anchor four-anchor final-vs-262k panel with positive pooled slope, at least three nonnegative anchor slopes, and both pooled seats nonnegative. A one-seed pass triggers replication, not a benchmark claim; a breadth failure changes the recipe. Deal start 16.1M is intentionally beyond all 13.1M/14.1M/15.1M prior windows.

Resume staging passed all nine gates. Parent actual=263,423, transition=230,710, iteration=56; assignment tail SHA f804eb29836d620f63074c8bd6ae4c06040bb2613cd15df44b5ef227e0deb652. New fixed-deal start 16,100,000 exceeds prior first-unused upper bound 13,117,714.

Progress audit at iteration94: cumulative actual=448,754, new=185,331; optimizer/replay continuous, no recovery boundary or KL stop, max observed rmax remains far below delta1. Iteration64 archive captured; loss-K-best admitted snapshot32 and retained fixed anchors.

Progress at iteration161: cumulative actual=773,330, new=509,907. Archives 96/128/160 captured; no optimizer/replay discontinuity, recovery boundary, KL stop, or ratio breach. Dynamic pool admitted snapshots32,59,67 while retaining fixed ids0/1/2.

Training finished naturally at iteration220 with 1,049,269 cumulative actual environment hands and 906,355 policy transitions; the exact continuation contributed 785,846 environment hands and 675,645 transitions. All 22 training integrity gates pass, including optimizer/replay/accounting/assignment RNG continuity, five archives, no replay recovery, max KL 0.001840, max reference KL 0.002378, and max importance ratio 1.52. A first audit artifact (training_audit.json) exposed an audit-only one-level lineage bug; training_audit_v2.json follows the immutable resume chain to the original iteration15 bridge binding and passes.

Frozen 1M-vs-262k common-deck panel completed 65,536 evaluation hands. Independent raw audit passed every evidence gate: 16,384 unique complete pairs, 4,096 per anchor, complete decks, exact SHA/checkpoint lineage, and exact recomputation. Pooled slope +2.7245 bb/100, 3/4 anchors nonnegative, both seats +4.2437/+1.2054. Standard10 anchor slope was -2.2156 but the separately preregistered capability-preservation audit passed (mean TV 0.01178, disagreement 1.135%). The preregistered research gate therefore promotes replication, not a benchmark or causal success claim.

result.summary: Exact-state Seed1 continuation finished at iteration 220 with 1,049,269 cumulative actual environment hands (785,846 new) and 906,355 cumulative policy transitions. All 22 continuation/training integrity gates passed. A frozen 65,536-hand four-anchor matched panel versus the 263k parent produced +2.7245 bb/100 (95% half-width 4.7559), 3/4 nonnegative anchors, and both seats positive; 20,000-state Standard10 preservation also passed.
result.conclusion: The integrated Trinal-Clip PPO/replay/loss-K-best/adaptive-league recipe shows a positive broad 262k-to-1M slope on the selected lineage without optimizer, replay, assignment-RNG, bridge-contract, or source-capability collapse. Raw evidence was independently recomputed and all integrity gates passed. The evidence is still one seed and not statistically conclusive: the pooled CI includes zero, the Standard10 matched anchor point estimate is -2.2156 bb/100, and this is not Slumbot evidence. It supports replication rather than a benchmark claim.
result.next_step: Continue the preregistered integrated recipe on an untouched second lineage from its frozen 263k checkpoint to approximately 1M actual environment hands with exact optimizer/replay/assignment state, then repeat the same fresh matched multi-anchor and Standard10-preservation audits. Use the cross-seed evidence and geometric curve behavior to decide whether scaling beyond 1M is justified.
